findings.summary: 判据 2a (GT-19) still has no discriminative executing test — third consecutive final review with this gap. The criterion demands the situation «wall-clock budget still ample but the attempt count is exhausted ⇒ the entry MUST continue», red when the limit logic reverts to count-primary. The delivered executing case builds the opposite situation: DRAIN_WALL_CLOCK_SECONDS=0 with DRAIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS=2, so bin/e0-regression.sh:386 fires on the very first iteration with DRAIN_ATTEMPT=0 and no drain is ever run (the fake deep-research-loop.sh stub is never invoked). Reinstating a count-primary check ahead of the wall-clock check leaves it green, because 0 >= 2 is false at that point — the assertion is insensitive to the exact ordering it claims to pin. The only remaining ordering coverage is :446-464, which reads bin/e0-regression.sh as text and compares the byte offsets of the literals "HIT WALL CLOCK LIMIT:" and "HIT ATTEMPT LIMIT" — the anti-pattern GT-23 names verbatim and that the two previous final reviews already flagged. No test anywhere (including test/e0c2-termination.test.ts:1099-1121, which sets maxAttempts=2 / wallClock=5 but asserts only a non-zero exit) asserts that the entry keeps draining past the attempt cap.

GT-22 / §1.1b violated: DRAIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS is no longer a safety net at all. In the drain loop only the wall clock can break (:386-402, LOOP_EXIT=4); the attempt cap survives solely as a secondary echo line printed INSIDE the wall-clock block (:388-390) and never terminates the loop or sets an exit code. GT-22 rejects exactly this degradation — «⛔ 失控兜底必须真的终止循环并非零退出；它只是要满足「正常情形下不会先于墙钟触发」，不是「永远不触发」» — and the previous version it condemned at least still printed a warning at exhaustion. §1.1b's requirement that the cap «在正常情形下不可能先于墙钟触发» presupposes it CAN fire abnormally; here it is structurally unreachable as a termination condition, while the profile (profiles/deploy/e0-regression.env:46-51) and its self-consistency test still present it as a live runaway bound.

The 判据 5 regression case asserts a property the code no longer has, and passes only by textual adjacency. Its name is «DRAIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS safety net still causes non-zero exit», but the assertion is a whole-file regex /HIT ATTEMPT LIMIT[\s\S]*LOOP_EXIT=4[\s\S]*break/, which matches the diagnostic echo at bin/e0-regression.sh:389 followed by the WALL-CLOCK block's LOOP_EXIT=4 / break at :400-401. Exhausting the attempt cap causes neither a break nor a non-zero exit, so this test reports green on a behaviour that does not exist — the same read-the-script-as-text family GT-23 forbids.

判据 3's triage half is now a placeholder rather than a test: it greps src/tick-run.ts for two diagnostic literals and asserts nothing about behaviour. The previous review's anti-pattern (reimplementing the wait loop in the test body) is indeed gone, and the behaviour is genuinely driven by the 判据 2z case at :584-658, so this adds no coverage — deleting it would lose nothing, while keeping it invites a false sense of coverage if the strings are ever reworded.

Genuinely fixed relative to rf-attempt_01KZX9ETF3NV2CFZ8JTATHZHT9: (1) 判据 2 is sound — workflows/deep-research/tick/workflow.yaml:14 sets node_timeout: 1800 with the 1800/904.2 ≈ 1.99× arithmetic and the DEFAULT_AGENT_RESULT_TIMEOUT_MS relation spelled out at :9-13, and the assertion at test/e0c9-node-timeout.test.ts:195-203 compares against the recorded measured maximum, not a source constant. (2) 判据 2b is now discriminative: the guard at :520 (nodeTimeout >= 904.2 × 1.99) turns the case red if §1.1 is reverted to 30, and the case drives a real runChannelWrite over a loopback HTTP fake bus and asserts result.termination is readable. (3) The prior 判据 1 blocker about live-machine coupling is resolved — the 判据 2a case now runs hermetically (symlinked entry, stub loop, two fake buses, overridden E0C1_PROD_BUS_URL, 30 s cap). (4) §1.1c/§1.2 handling at src/tick-run.ts:1638-1658 and :1737-1742 records the local failure and continues while a bus-unreachable error still throws, covered by 判据 2z in both directions.

This final judgment is formed independently of the Continuous review committed in the RC subject (rc-attempt_01KZXB0S82P2VRQ46WH4RMRWWG, APPROVE with zero findings, reviewer glm/code-plan). That verdict is recorded but not adopted: it surfaces neither the still-missing 判据 2a discriminant nor the removal of the attempt-cap safety net that GT-22 requires to actually terminate.
